Split the conjunction into two standard polynomial-stability arguments.

For the first component, view \(q\) as an \(f\)-invariant submodule: \(q\leq\operatorname{comap}(f,q)\) means \(x\in q\Rightarrow f(x)\in q\). Prove that every iterate \(f^n(m)\) lies in \(q\), then use the finite-sum representation
\[
p(f)(m)=\sum_n p_n\cdot f^n(m).
\]
Closure of \(q\) under scalar multiplication and addition gives the result. Equivalently, organize this as polynomial induction using constants, \(X\), addition, and multiplication.

For the equivalence, observe that both universally quantified statements are unconditional consequences of the universal property of \(R[X]\), so prove each direction independently:

- `aevalTower` sends constants according to \(g\), hence its underlying ring hom composed with `Polynomial.C` is \(g\).
- Any \(R\)-algebra hom \(\varphi:R[X]\to A\) is evaluation at \(\varphi(X)\), giving
  \[
  \varphi(p)=\operatorname{eval₂}(\operatorname{algebraMap}R A)(\varphi(X))(p).
  \]

Thus each implication may discard its hypothesis and invoke the corresponding polynomial evaluation identity.
